CURRENT_STATE_C0.maturity: Stage-2 confidence tiers by span: none<3d, low<7d, building<30d, mature>=30d; gate uses mature only

CURRENT_STATE_C0.presentation_baseline_out_of_scope: BETA_HORIZON_TOD_V2 same-UTC-time +-30min median over 30 prior days, mature 20 days, pooled weekday types; descriptive only

CANDIDATE_C1_PRIMARY.weekday_type_rule: UTC date of the window end; Sat/Sun = WEEKEND
CANDIDATE_C1_PRIMARY.rationale: minimal change to the current construction; tests the found calibration problem without changing the horizon

SECONDARY_C1_LONG.role: sensitivity only; cannot decide; may become primary only by a written amendment before any Stage H count

COUNTING_UNIT: non-overlapping hourly windows with usable ranks; 5m-step rates reported beside

METRICS.primary: P_S = max over WEEKDAY/WEEKEND and metrics of |G_S|

GUARDRAILS.availability_surface_B: A_C1(s) >= A_C0(s) - 0.05 and CS(s) >= A_C0(s) - 0.05 per primary stratum; tolerance set from the 10% tape-completeness tolerance, not from any result

STAGE_H.label: HISTORICAL / EXPOSED / PROXY EVALUATION
STAGE_H.classification: whole surface historically exposed for this decision (R03 published weekend-vs-weekday differences on it); no historical holdout exists or is created
can: direction and rough size of calibration error
also_reports: surface B availability (calendar-driven on the gapless pinned panel)
empirical date-cluster DEFF (descriptive; may only raise the Stage P requirement)
STAGE_H.semantics: eligibility / sanity gate only; no evidentiary weight; confirmatory evidence comes from Stage P alone
STAGE_H.fixes_for_stage_P: nothing (may only raise the information requirement by pre-P amendment)

STAGE_P.label: PROSPECTIVE / CONFIRMATORY
STAGE_P.data: beta state tape schema V2, after the start bucket
STAGE_P.start_rule: first UTC 00:00 bucket at which both C0 and C1 have usable weekend and weekday ranks (mature tier; C1 also 8 same-type dates), determined mechanically from counts; calendar expectation only: late October 2026

information_requirement.definition: DEFF is a planning VARIANCE design effect
information_requirement.amendment_rule: if Stage H empirical date-cluster DEFF > 2.5, raise each requirement to ceil(DEFF_H * n_indep / 50) * 50 before Stage P; never lower

STAGE_P.stop_rule: first UTC Monday 00:00 at which both primary strata hold >= 2250 common-support hours; hard cap 52 weeks after start -> INCONCLUSIVE; expected clock at full availability: 47 weekends
STAGE_P.no_tuning_after_H: only a written amendment before Stage P starts (new design version) or a restart on later data under a new preregistration

inference.clusters: UTC dates d=1..G with >=1 common-support hour
inference.sufficient_statistics: same n_d for both schemes; x_{S,d} flagged hours
inference.level: E_S = sum x_{S,d} / N; u_{S,d} = x_{S,d} - E_S n_d; Var(E_S) = G/(G-1) * sum u^2 / N^2
inference.paired: Delta = sum (x_{C1,d} - x_{C0,d}) / N; v_d = (x_{C1,d} - x_{C0,d}) - Delta n_d; Var(Delta) = G/(G-1) * sum v_d^2 / N^2
inference.week_sensitivity: same formulas with ISO-week clusters; decision uses the larger of the date and week SEs (frozen now)

temporal_diversity_rule.reason: redundant: 2250 weekend hours span >= 47 ISO weeks (<= 48 per week), 2250 weekday hours >= 19 weeks (<= 120 per week); max single-week share 2.1% / 5.3%; > 3 months necessarily

counts_only_storage_model.at_stop: one run computes per-date sufficient statistics n_d, x_{S,d,m}, paired per-date differences, qualified and triggered counts, and publishes them with the estimates

hard_cap_feasibility.verdict: weekday comfortable; weekend has no margin: feasible only if A_C0(WEEKEND) >= ~0.95 and C1 loses almost nothing; census decides; else DESIGN_BLOCKED_BY_FEASIBILITY and owner chooses (price SE/band, price secondary, longer cap)

prestop_allowed_fields: per-venue and cross-venue presence booleans of the 12 buckets (no values)
single fixed unusable reason per scheme
prestop_forbidden: TRIGGERED / episode counts (scheme-independent but not needed; computed once at the stop)

DECISION_RULE.H_REFUTES: P_C1 > P_C0 + 0.005 or a guardrail breached -> C1 closed
DECISION_RULE.P_PASS: min N and diversity met; on common support |G_C1| <= 0.02 in both primary strata for all metrics and P_C1 <= P_C0; all guardrails incl. availability hold
DECISION_RULE.P_FAIL: any guardrail breached, or |G_C1| > 0.03, or P_C1 > P_C0 + 0.005
DECISION_RULE.P_INCONCLUSIVE: otherwise or min N unmet at the hard cap
DECISION_RULE.PRODUCT: PASS iff H_ELIGIBLE_FOR_PROSPECTIVE (gate) and P_PASS (the only confirmatory test) -> proposal under PRODUCT_FIRST_DECISION_V1 section 11; FAIL iff H_REFUTES or P_FAIL; else INCONCLUSIVE
DECISION_RULE.H_ELIGIBLE_FOR_PROSPECTIVE: P_C1 <= P_C0 - 0.01, assessable guardrails hold, min N met; eligibility only

STOP_CONDITIONS: product rule / cut / venue minimum / context version / tape schema change during Stage P
gate absent from main at Stage P start
any pre-stop read of a Stage P rate (stage void)
NO_LOOKAHEAD: ranks at t use buckets strictly before t
weekday type of a sample from its own window end
Stage P read once at the count-defined stop
no evaluation-period data sets a threshold
no value-derived stratification edge enters any gate; descriptive terciles computed only at the stop
FORBIDDEN_DATA: opened 2025-01..2026-08-15 surface unless the owner decides otherwise (sensitivity only)
R03 unit files and results as inputs
PREREQUISITES: timestamp-only tape census (presence only, no values) to fix PROSPECTIVE_START and expected availability; if read as data opening, first step after freeze
offline evaluator with PIT, weekday-type, one-per-hour, usability-reason and census-no-values tests; no product code change
freeze of thresholds/start/stop/terciles before Stage P; owner Stage P activation and opening
OWNER_DECISIONS_PENDING: run the census on the deploy host (operator) and read its verdict
hard cap if DESIGN_BLOCKED_BY_FEASIBILITY (separate authorization from the decision memo)

COMMON_SUPPORT_RULE: primary comparison C0 vs C1 is paired on hours usable under both schemes; G_C0 and G_C1 computed on exactly the same hours
